method: Final-system classifier + FAISS retrieval + grounded draft + live Gemini judge. Reply text is never inserted as its own evidence. When the routing gate escalates, a forced evidence-grounded draft is still generated so hard cases enter the judge study.
generation_note: Drafts for this frozen study used MockLLM evidence-conditioned templates after live Gemini generation hit sustained 429/timeouts; judge scores were produced with live Gemini against the retrieved evidence blob.
